answer: Per-identity stake + slashing. Each identity must lock 200 DAI in a slashing escrow at the registration inlet and bind one unique Ed25519 key before voting/grading. A 1000-clone farm pays 200,000 DAI upfront; when the audit finds the clone grove (same graph component) sharing one deposit wharf address, slashing burns all 200,000 DAI. Honesty stays cheaper.
